recipes.title: Fluffy Farmer Cheese Chocolate Chip Pancakes (30 meal-prep pancakes)

groups.name: Batter (for 30; divide by 3 for a normal batch)

steps: Whisk the farmer cheese, eggs, vanilla, maple syrup and mashed banana until fairly smooth, then fold in the self-rising flour and chocolate chips.
Cook scoops of batter in a buttered skillet (ring molds make tall, fluffy pancakes) over medium-low heat until golden, then flip.
Cool, stack with parchment between and refrigerate or freeze; reheat in a toaster, microwave or skillet.
recipes.notes: Recipe and macros are the creator's, per pancake (approximate). Sponsored post: he uses Lifeway farmer cheese and kefir butter, but any farmer cheese or blended cottage cheese works.
